## About
Mellon Street Garage is a local shop on Mellon Street in East Liberty. We work under the hood, in the body shop and on your wheels and tires.
Isaac owns the shop, and Tae is there helping customers too. People from the neighborhood and folks just passing through Pittsburgh have trusted us with their cars, and we hold a 4 rating from 62 Google reviews.

## Services
- State inspections: Pennsylvania state inspections, including emission inspection.
- Oil & Filter Changes: Routine oil and filter service to keep your engine running right.
- Engine, fuel systems, emissions, & performance: Diagnosis and repair under the hood.
- Air conditioning & heater service: Getting your heat and air conditioning working again.
- Professional Automotive Painting: Paint work along with paint repair and paint restoration.
- All Types of Damage Repair: Body work and collision repair for all kinds of car damage.
- Transmission & clutch service: Transmission fluid service, automatic transmission replacement and re-sealing, and clutch and pressure plate service.
- New /used Tire Sales: New and used tires, plus balancing, repair, disposal and wheel alignment.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 745 Mellon St in East Liberty, Pittsburgh, PA 15206.

Q: Do you do emission inspections?
A: Yes. We do state inspections and emission inspections right here in East Liberty.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes, we sell both new and used tires, and we can balance, repair and dispose of them too.
